# Quick AI Sepolia Desk

> Base Sepolia (84532) Uniswap V2 DEX front end for funding LPs and swapping. No farms. No staking. No V3 NFTs.

## Links
- Live UI: https://sepolia.quickai.build
- Source: https://github.com/Quick-AI-LLC/sepolia-desk

## Network
- Base Sepolia
- Chain ID: 84532
- Use: approve -> addLiquidity -> swapExactTokensForTokens
- Not: Uniswap V3 Position Manager
